overall: Atlanta is currently at the overnight low of 75.2°F (as of 00:30 ET), with essentially no thermal trend yet as the day hasn't begun warming. max_temp_prediction: The META fused model places the highest probability mass in the 88-89°F and 90-91°F buckets (28.1% each), and the Tier 1 odd-bucket ensemble signal at 89-90°F (26.8%, high confidence) converges strongly with the NWS forecast of 89°F and HRRR at 88.5°F. The main downside risk is early-afternoon convection suppressing the peak; the main upside risk is delayed storms allowing full afternoon heating. Best estimate is approximately 88.5°F, with a plausible range of 86–91°F.
